1. Tap “Pair through notification” and allow notifications. On Android 17 or later, also allow nearby-device access for local discovery.
2. In Developer options, open Wireless debugging, enable it, then choose “Pair device with pairing code”.
3. Keep that pairing-code dialog open. Pull down the notification shade, enter its six-digit code in the TensorIMS notification, and send it. Do not return to this app to enter the code.
The app discovers the ports automatically, then connects and verifies the private service after pairing.
Pairing applies only to this app on this device. The pairing code is not saved or logged. Wireless debugging is enabled only by you in Android Settings.
Pair through notification
Already paired? Enable Wireless debugging and use the button below to discover its current connection port and restart the private service. If Android has forgotten this app, pair again.
Reconnect paired device
Preparing the pairing notification…
Waiting for you to open “Pair device with pairing code” in Wireless debugging…
Pairing port found. Keep the Android pairing dialog open and enter the code in the notification.
Pairing this app… Keep the Android pairing dialog open.
Discovering the wireless debugging connection port…
Starting and verifying the private service…
Private service startup verified.
Wireless debugging setup did not complete. Review the details below, then retry.
This action continues while Android Settings is open. Mode changes and other startup actions are blocked until it finishes or is canceled.
Cancel wireless setup
Notifications are required

The pairing code must be sent from a notification while the Android pairing dialog stays open. Enable app notifications and the wireless debugging notification channel in Settings, then return and tap the pairing or reconnect button again.
Local discovery permission is required

On Android 17 or later, automatic wireless debugging discovery needs the nearby-devices local network permission. Allow it in this app’s Permissions settings, then return and tap the pairing or reconnect button again.
Open permission settings
